name: Axiom Workforce Solutions Content Group
description: Technically a subsidiary of Vantablack Media operating under exclusive contract to Axiom Corponation, AWSCG produces all mandatory neural-feed corporate training, compliance orientation, and behavioral recalibration content used across Axiom's workforce. The content is not voluntary — Tier 2 Axiom employees are required to complete a minimum of forty hours annually. Former employees describe sessions as indistinguishable from targeted memory replacement.
cultural_impact: Established the legal and technical precedent for mandatory neural-feed consumption as a condition of employment, a framework now used by seven major corponations.
story_hooks: Someone needs to extract a worker from an Axiom facility mid-mandatory session before a particularly aggressive recalibration module completes
A copy of an unreleased AWSCG module has surfaced on the underground market — it appears to be designed for executives, not workers
A disgruntled AWSCG content designer has hidden something inside a compliance module that millions of Axiom employees have already experienced
